question: The Shalimar Gardens located in Lahore and Kashmir are architectures of the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mughals**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Shalimar Gardens** located in Lahore and Kashmir are masterpieces of Mughal architecture.
 
• The gardens were constructed during the reign of the Mughal Emperor **Shah Jahan** in the 17th century.
 
• The Shalimar Gardens in Lahore are a UNESCO World Heritage Site and are known for their terraced lawns, fountains, and marble pavilions.
 
• The Shalimar Bagh in Kashmir, also known as the "abode of love," is famed for its exquisite design and scenic beauty, reflecting the grandeur of the Mughal era.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Mughal Empire, which ruled most of India and Pakistan in the 16th and 17th centuries, is known for its contributions to art, culture, and architecture.
 
• Other notable Mughal architectural achievements include the **Taj Mahal**, the **Red Fort**, and the **Jama Masjid**.
 
• Mughal gardens are characterized by their symmetrical layout, use of water features, and incorporation of Persian design elements.
 
• The Mughal period is often regarded as a golden age of Indian architecture and culture, marked by significant advancements in building techniques and artistic expression.
 
• The influence of Mughal architecture can still be seen in many structures across South Asia today.
